summary: Targeted frontend test of hamburger menu bug fix on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). All 5 acceptance criteria pass: header shows only logo + hamburger on both viewports (no inline nav links), clicking hamburger opens dropdown with all 6 nav links (Menú, Desayunos, Tiendita, Galería, Estante, Visítanos) + Admin link at bottom with small spaced letters, clicking a nav link closes the menu, and Admin link navigates to /admin/login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hamburger menu is confirmed working on all viewports. Note: a 'Menú' button also exists in the hero/CTA area which is unrelated to the header nav (showed up as visible count=1 before opening hamburger) — not a bug.
rca of the issue: Fix (removal of md: responsive classes) verified working: header nav uses 'hidden' always, hamburger uses no md:hidden, so hamburger appears on all breakpoints.
